verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs show a native CI/CD pipeline capability through GitHub Actions, which automates and runs workflows in the repository (also reachable from the GitHub CLI). The evidence never documents where those pipelines run or how they are monitored centrally. A community comment only speculates that self-hosted runners would be needed and does not concretely contradict any vendor claim. missing for 10: explicit documentation of platform-hosted runners, documentation of self-hosted/private runners, centralized visibility or monitoring across runners, independent hands-on corroboration.
